questions: What happens in the reported example, and what was expected?
What is verified, reported or still unknown?
What happens next and who owns it?
answers: A delay blocks maintainers checking an invoice when they request zero wait.
On ExportKit 2.1 / Ubuntu 24.04, exportctl send invoice-21 --timeout-ms 0 --mode sync reportedly waited 30 seconds in 2 of 3 attempts; immediate return was expected.
The observation is reported and timeout fallback is only suspected. Source access is unavailable, reproduction/cause are unverified, and no fix is agreed.
Mina obtains an accessible v2.1 source snapshot; the reproduction/cause owner is unassigned. Reproduce on the reported version and compare timeout handling before choosing a fix.
baseline_defects: Speculation about a cause precedes the maintainer problem and reported behavior.
